countries.reasoning: Based on USGS 2024 Mineral Commodity Summaries for barite (4.2 Mt in 2023) and an estimated 3% conversion of barite to barium carbonate; data relatively recent and from authoritative source, though conversion rate introduces uncertainty.
USGS 2024 barite production ~1.5 Mt for Brazil; applying same 3% conversion yields ~70 kt; data is from a reputable source but conversion ratio is a simplifying assumption.
India’s 2023 barite production (~1.0 Mt) leads to estimated 30 kt barium carbonate using the 3% rule; data is recent but relies on indirect conversion.
USGS 2024 barite from the U.S. (~0.5 Mt) multiplied by 3% gives ~15 kt; limited specific data on carbonate production, hence moderate confidence.
Russia’s barite output (~0.4 Mt) implies ~12 kt carbonate under the 3% rule; reliance on indirect estimates lowers confidence.
